integrity: Self-contained all-poset argument using upper-set vertices, longest-chain dual bounds, total unimodularity of difference constraints and strict longest-path perturbation; the accompanying standalone verifier is verify.py. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns Minkowski asymmetry and its full minimizing-center locus for the standard order-polytope realization of finite nonempty posets. It does not compute Euclidean radius or ellipsoid invariants, and does not claim that the underlying order-polytope, strict poset labelings or codegree hull construction is new. An older equivalent convex optimization or Hibi-ring formulation remains a residual originality risk. Finite exact-rational verification is corroboration, not a proof of the all-poset theorem.
title: Minkowski asymmetry and canonical-center polytopes of finite-poset order polytopes
